title: Reconciliation is the object model, installation is only an action
summary: The core abstraction is reconcile target with declared state. Discovery, assessment, planning, apply and verification are separate phases so an already-correct machine can yield NO_ACTION_REQUIRED and a changed or damaged machine can be repaired deterministically.
invariants: Identical manifest + discovery + policy should produce the same plan.
A second discovery after successful deployment should have zero required unsatisfied conditions.
Repeated reconciliation covers initial install, repair, drift, upgrades, corruption and configuration change.

provenance.claim: Separates discover, assess, plan, apply and verify semantics.
Defines deterministic plans, no hidden mutation and idempotence.
Defines repeated reconciliation as the common repair/update model.
States that reconcile-target-with-declared-state is the central abstraction.
